# Distribution & Storefront Assets

This directory stores marketing, storefront, and publishing assets for **Supermassive Whitehole** (itch.io, social media, press kit).

---

## Files

| File | Purpose | Recommended Dimensions | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `screenshot_title.png` | Title screen screenshot | 128×64 (or scaled 2:1 integer ratio e.g. 640×320) | Displays game title, high score, press A prompt |
| `screenshot_gameplay.png` | In-game action screenshot | 128×64 (or scaled 2:1 integer ratio e.g. 640×320) | Displays player sprite dodging swirling whitehole |
| `cover.png` *(to add)* | itch.io Project Cover Art | 630×500 px (or 315×250 minimum) | Main thumbnail shown in search & browse feeds |
| `favicon.png` *(to add)* | Browser tab icon | 32×32 or 64×64 px | Displayed in browser tabs |
| `banner.png` *(optional)* | itch.io profile / page banner | 960×400 px | Header banner for the game's itch page |

---

## itch.io Submission Checklist

1. **Cover Image**: Upload `cover.png` in the **Cover image** section of Edit Game.
2. **Screenshots**: Upload `screenshot_title.png` and `screenshot_gameplay.png` to the **Screenshots** carousel.
3. **HTML5 Zip**: Upload `dist/supermassive-whitehole-web.zip` as executable HTML playable in browser.
4. **Hardware Hex**: Upload `dist/supermassive-whitehole.hex` as downloadable file for physical Arduboy users.
